notes: Small tight bush for filling verges and rock bases. Three lobes and few cuts keeps it chunky, which matters more at this size than at any other: a small round form with many facets just reads as noise.

rules.placement: Small tight bush for filling verges and rock bases; keep chunky and clustered, not freestanding mid-field.
rules.avoid: Avoid desert and alpine; not for open sand or snowfields.
